nodes.code:
from fpdf import FPDF

def sanitize(t):
    t = t or ''
    t = t.replace('\u2014', '-').replace('\u2013', '-').replace('\u2018', "'").replace('\u2019', "'").replace('\u201c', '"').replace('\u201d', '"').replace('\u2026', '...')
    return t.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1')

def get_section(lines, keywords):
    start = None
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        s2 = line.strip()
        if s2.startswith('#') and any(k.lower() in s2.lower() for k in keywords):
            start = i + 1
            break
    if start is None:
        return []
    end = len(lines)
    for j in range(start, len(lines)):
        if lines[j].strip().startswith('#'):
            end = j
            break
    return lines[start:end]

def empty_state(lines):
    candidates = []
    for l in lines:
        s2 = l.strip()
        if not s2:
            continue
        if s2.startswith('#'):
            continue
        if '{{' in s2:
            continue
        if s2.startswith('|'):
            continue
        if set(s2) <= set('-|: '):
            continue
        candidates.append(s2.strip('_* '))
    return candidates[-1] if candidates else 'No data available for this period.'

template_text = params.get('template_text') or ''
lines = template_text.splitlines()

attendance_section = get_section(lines, ['Attendance Summary'])
scorecard_section = get_section(lines, ['Performance Scorecard', 'Scorecard'])
past_section = get_section(lines, ['Past Month Events', 'Past Events'])
upcoming_section = get_section(lines, ['Upcoming Events'])

attendance_empty = sanitize(empty_state(attendance_section))
scorecard_empty = sanitize(empty_state(scorecard_section))
past_empty = sanitize(empty_state(past_section))
upcoming_empty = sanitize(empty_state(upcoming_section))

tenant_name = sanitize(params.get('tenant_name') or '')
client_name = sanitize(params.get('client_name') or '')
month_label = sanitize(params.get('month_label') or '')
month_yyyy_mm = params.get('month_yyyy_mm') or ''
generated_date = sanitize(params.get('generated_date') or '')
attendance_pct = params.get('attendance_pct')
office_days_pct = params.get('office_days_pct')
leave_taken_days = params.get('leave_taken_days')
has_attendance_data = params.get('has_attendance_data') or False
scorecard_rows = params.get('scorecard_rows') or []
has_scorecard_data = params.get('has_scorecard_data') or False
past_events = params.get('past_events') or []
upcoming_events = params.get('upcoming_events') or []
gallery_paths = params.get('gallery_paths') or []
portal_id = params.get('portal_id') or ''

pdf = FPDF()
pdf.set_auto_page_break(auto=True, margin=15)
pdf.add_page()
usable = pdf.w - pdf.l_margin - pdf.r_margin

pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 20)
pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
pdf.cell(usable, 12, sanitize(f'{client_name} - Monthly Report'), new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT', align='C')
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', '', 12)
pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
pdf.cell(usable, 8, sanitize(f'Period: {month_label} ({month_yyyy_mm})'), new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT', align='C')
pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
pdf.cell(usable, 8, sanitize(f'Prepared for: {tenant_name}'), new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT', align='C')
pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
pdf.cell(usable, 8, sanitize(f'Generated: {generated_date}'), new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT', align='C')
pdf.ln(6)

pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 14)
pdf.cell(usable, 10, '1. Employee Attendance Summary', new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', '', 11)
pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
if has_attendance_data:
    ap = attendance_pct if attendance_pct is not None else 0.0
    od = office_days_pct if office_days_pct is not None else 0.0
    lt = leave_taken_days if leave_taken_days is not None else 0.0
    pdf.multi_cell(usable, 8, sanitize(f'Attendance: {ap:.1f}%\nOffice Days: {od:.1f}%\nLeave Taken: {lt:.1f} days'))
else:
    pdf.multi_cell(usable, 8, attendance_empty)
pdf.ln(4)

pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 14)
pdf.cell(usable, 10, '2. Monthly Performance Scorecard', new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
if has_scorecard_data and scorecard_rows:
    col_w = usable / 4
    pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
    pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 10)
    pdf.cell(col_w, 8, 'Employee', border=1)
    pdf.cell(col_w, 8, 'Attendance %', border=1)
    pdf.cell(col_w, 8, 'Office Days %', border=1)
    pdf.cell(col_w, 8, 'Leave Days', border=1, new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
    pdf.set_font('Helvetica', '', 10)
    for row in scorecard_rows:
        name = sanitize(row.get('name') or '')
        a = row.get('attendance_pct')
        o = row.get('office_days_pct')
        l = row.get('leave_taken_days')
        pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
        pdf.cell(col_w, 8, name, border=1)
        pdf.cell(col_w, 8, (f'{a:.1f}' if a is not None else '-'), border=1)
        pdf.cell(col_w, 8, (f'{o:.1f}' if o is not None else '-'), border=1)
        pdf.cell(col_w, 8, (f'{l:.1f}' if l is not None else '-'), border=1, new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
else:
    pdf.set_font('Helvetica', '', 11)
    pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
    pdf.multi_cell(usable, 8, scorecard_empty)
pdf.ln(4)

pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 14)
pdf.cell(usable, 10, '3. Past Month Events', new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', '', 11)
if past_events:
    for ev in past_events:
        heading = sanitize(ev.get('heading') or '')
        body = sanitize(ev.get('body') or '')
        pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
        pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 11)
        pdf.multi_cell(usable, 8, heading)
        pdf.set_font('Helvetica', '', 11)
        pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
        pdf.multi_cell(usable, 8, body)
        pdf.ln(2)
else:
    pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
    pdf.multi_cell(usable, 8, past_empty)
pdf.ln(4)

pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 14)
pdf.cell(usable, 10, '4. Upcoming Events', new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
pdf.set_font('Helvetica', '', 11)
if upcoming_events:
    for ev in upcoming_events:
        heading = sanitize(ev.get('heading') or '')
        body = sanitize(ev.get('body') or '')
        pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
        pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 11)
        pdf.multi_cell(usable, 8, heading)
        pdf.set_font('Helvetica', '', 11)
        pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
        pdf.multi_cell(usable, 8, body)
        pdf.ln(2)
else:
    pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
    pdf.multi_cell(usable, 8, upcoming_empty)
pdf.ln(4)

if gallery_paths:
    pdf.set_x(pdf.l_margin)
    pdf.set_font('Helvetica', 'B', 14)
    pdf.cell(usable, 10, '5. Photo Gallery', new_x='LMARGIN', new_y='NEXT')
    cols = 2
    col_w = usable / cols - 4
    y = pdf.get_y()
    x_start = pdf.l_margin
    for idx, img_path in enumerate(gallery_paths):
        col = idx % cols
        if col == 0 and idx != 0:
            y = y + col_w + 6
        if y + col_w > pdf.h - pdf.b_margin:
            pdf.add_page()
            y = pdf.t_margin
        x = x_start + col * (col_w + 4)
        pdf.image(img_path, x=x, y=y, w=col_w)
    pdf.set_y(y + col_w + 6)

pdf_path = api.files.scratch_path(f'{month_yyyy_mm}.pdf')
pdf.output(pdf_path)
saved_path = f'Monthly Reports/{month_yyyy_mm}.pdf'
api.files.put(file=saved_path, scratch_file=pdf_path, scope='client', scope_id=portal_id)
saved_path = saved_path or ''
